_comment: Canonical check catalog. Evidence attaches to checks; ca_control_check_map fans checks out to controls across frameworks. logic_key must exist in ca/checks_registry.py REGISTRY (loader-validated). Params are per-check: never weaken a check to make cross-framework overlap prettier — strictest framework gets its own check.

checks.name: Vulnerability scan completed within the last quarter
checks.description: At least one COMPLETED vulnerability scan run exists in the last 92 days.

checks.name: Vulnerability scan completed within the last month
checks.description: At least one COMPLETED vulnerability scan run exists in the last 31 days.

checks.name: No open critical vulnerabilities
checks.description: Zero vulnerability findings with severity=critical in an active (unresolved) status.

checks.name: No high/critical findings past remediation SLA
checks.description: No active findings of severity high or critical whose sla_due_at is in the past.

checks.name: Active assets covered by vulnerability scanning
checks.description: At least 80% of active assets were targeted by a completed scan in the last 90 days.

checks.name: Remediations verified by rescan
checks.description: Findings moved to verified/closed are backed by a scan run completed after remediation.

checks.name: Recurring scan schedule active
checks.description: At least one active INTERVAL/CRON scan or discovery schedule exists with a future next run.

checks.name: Asset inventory maintained
checks.description: Asset inventory is non-empty and has been updated within the last 90 days.

checks.name: Asset ownership verified
checks.description: At least 80% of active assets have completed ownership verification.

checks.name: External attack surface monitored
checks.description: ASM discovery has completed within the last 30 days for the organization's assets.

checks.name: Administrative audit logging operative
checks.description: Platform audit log records organization activity within the last 30 days.

checks.name: Access changes tracked and roles assigned
checks.description: Org membership uses role-based access; membership/role changes are recorded in the audit log.

checks.name: Information security policy active and acknowledged
checks.description: An active information-security policy exists, is within its review window, and ≥80% of members acknowledged the current version.

checks.name: Access control policy active and acknowledged
checks.description: An active access-control policy exists, is within its review window, and ≥80% of members acknowledged the current version.

checks.name: Incident response policy active and acknowledged
checks.description: An active incident-response policy exists, is within its review window, and ≥80% of members acknowledged the current version.

checks.name: Annual penetration test report
checks.description: A penetration test report from the last 12 months, uploaded as manual evidence.

checks.name: Annual risk assessment
checks.description: A documented organizational risk assessment from the last 12 months.

checks.name: Business continuity / DR test
checks.description: Evidence of a business continuity or disaster recovery exercise in the last 12 months.

checks.name: Vendor / third-party security review
checks.description: Documented review of critical vendors' security posture in the last 12 months.

checks.name: Security awareness training records
checks.description: Records showing workforce security-awareness training completed in the last 12 months.

checks.name: Consent management records (DPDP)
checks.description: Documentation of consent collection/withdrawal mechanisms for personal data (DPDP Act).

checks.name: Breach notification procedure
checks.description: Documented procedure for notifying authorities/individuals of breaches within the mandated window (e.g. CERT-In 6h, GDPR 72h).

checks.name: 180-day log retention (CERT-In)
checks.description: Evidence that security logs are retained for a rolling 180 days as required by CERT-In directions.

checks.name: Clock synchronization to NPL/NIC (CERT-In)
checks.description: Evidence that systems synchronize clocks to NPL/NIC NTP as required by CERT-In directions.
